[[Category:Operating Systems]]
Allocate a memory segment based on pages.

If you want a certain amount of memory you request the creation of a segment, which is a certain amount of pages allocated at once


==Starting virtual memory for real==

Basic idea is that you can have a logical page that is used and virtual then it will be loaded into ram (into a frame) until the cpu requests that.

* Pages: abstracted memory segment
** abstract logical thing
** also stored on hard disk
* Frames: segment of RAM

==Page replacement algorithm examples==
First in First out
